name: Cunning Reflexes (Combat)
body:
You are perceptive enough to spot the weak points in an enemy’s movement, and take advantage of them.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 13, Perception 1 rank.

Benefit(s): You gain an additional attack of opportunity plus one for every 5 ranks in Perception you possess. This feat does not stack with the additional attacks of opportunity granted by Combat Reflexes.

Special: This feat counts as Combat Reflexes for the purpose of meeting prerequisites and you may use your Wisdom score in place of your Dexterity score to meet prerequisites of feats with Combat Reflexes as a prerequisite.
